import sys, json, random; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
import max96
from protocol import loads, validate
def force(case, nissues):
    ev = []
    for i in range(nissues):
        ev.append({'op':'issue','id':10000+i,'worker':i % len(case['workers'])})
        ev.append({'op':'deliver','id':10000+i})
        ev.append({'op':'step'})
    ev.append({'op':'audit'})
    case['events'] = ev
    return case
cases = [force(max96.build(i, mode=('route' if i%2==0 else 'admit'), cap=1, demand=1000, events=8), 8) for i in range(6)]
t = json.dumps({'cases': cases}, separators=(',',':'))
req = validate(loads(t))
print('events', sum(len(c['events']) for c in req['cases']), 'issues', sum(1 for c in req['cases'] for e in c['events'] if e['op']=='issue'))
open('/tmp/max48.json','w').write(t)
